content.short: API3 enables developers to build trustless applications that connect to real-world data via APIs using Airnode.
content.description: API3 is a first-party oracle solution launched in December 2020, designed to give developers a direct path from real-world data to their dApps through APIs. By connecting dApps to real-world data streams via APIs, API3 enables on-chain access to external information. API owners can also participate through API3, broadening the pool of data sources available for Web3 projects. Central to the platform is Airnode technology, which can turn regular APIs into data sources that are easily integrated into Web3.
